description: Create or revise an Artifact node — a real deliverable (file/spec/doc) that lives outside the graph, pointed to by `location`. Lands with no status unless you pass one: absent means nobody said. CONTENT FIELDS ARE REQUIRED TO CREATE AND OPTIONAL TO REVISE: call it again with the same id and only what you are changing — omitted fields keep their stored value, so correcting one never means re-sending a 2 KB field you did not touch. Ask for this when you want to register a file, drawing or document in the design.

ArtifactInputArg.description: One input a kept output took (add_artifact `inputs`).

checksum.description:
For a kept output: the checksum of the version the record used. Omitted: the version
the design holds now.

input.description: The record's own name for this input (`persons`).

node_id.description:
The design quantity (a Constraint holding a `limit`) or the kept output (an Artifact) the
record took. Anything else is refused: a number written only in prose is first recorded
as a quantity.

unit.description: For a quantity: the unit of `value`, which must be the unit the design holds it in.

value.description:
For a quantity: the value the record used. Omitted: the quantity's value now is taken,
and the edge says so (`used_basis: current`).

checksum.description:
A content hash of the file (`sha256:<hex>`) — the baseline that makes a later edit detectable.
Supply it on creation, as `link_artifact` does: without one, `reconcile_artifacts` can say the file
vanished but never that its contents changed. On a REVISE of an artifact that already carries one it
is REFUSED — moving a baseline is a drift disposition, which is `set_artifact_checksum`'s job.

description.description:
WHAT THIS IS, in prose. Added 2026-09-07: `description` is the only
prose field this type declares, and no tool offered it, so the surface
let a caller NAME the thing and never say what it was — six of eleven
types that declare a description were in that state, because the class
was fixed one report at a time and never swept
(`fact:six-constructors-cannot-write-any-prose-because-the-class-was-fixed-one-report-at-a-time-and-never-swept`).

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

id.description: The artifact's id — `art:<slug>` by convention, so the prefix names the type wherever the id appears. Calling again with an EXISTING id REVISES that node: what you pass overwrites, what you omit survives.

information_credibility.description:
HOW CREDIBLE WHAT IT SAYS IS, Admiralty scale: `1` confirmed … `4`
doubtful, `5` improbable, `6` cannot be judged. Graded 4 to 6, it
checks no citation. Omitted: nothing is written.

inputs.description:
A KEPT OUTPUT'S INPUTS: for a calculator's record, a drawing or a render, every design
quantity (a Constraint with a `limit`) and every other kept output (an Artifact) it took,
with what it USED, so a later change names it owed a re-run (loop_status
`owed_computations`; propagate_from `redo_list`). One DEPENDS_ON edge per input. Passing
it REPLACES the artifact's whole input set (`[]` clears it); omitted, the inputs stay as
they are. Register a re-run's new version with what IT used. reflow2 never reads the file.

location.description: Path / URI / content-hash of the real deliverable (lives outside the graph).

not_read.description:
NAMED, NOT READ: a source named somewhere that nobody read. It never
counts as citing — what it DOCUMENTS stays uncited — and a checksum on
it pins nothing. Omitted: nothing is written.

source_reliability.description:
THE SOURCE'S RELIABILITY, on the Admiralty scale evidence uses: `A`
completely reliable … `D` not usually reliable, `E` unreliable, `F`
cannot be judged. Graded D to F, it checks no citation: what it
documents reads unverified. Omitted: nothing is written.

status.description:
`planned` / `in_progress` / `realized` / `verified`. NO DEFAULT since 2026-09-16: it used to
land `realized` with no way to say otherwise, so an artifact registered before the file
existed read as produced. Absent means nobody said. `link_artifact` sets `realized` itself,
because it read the file's checksum off disk.

title: Add an Artifact
